The IO module provides file system, input/output, and console control utilities.
It includes global IO helper functions as well as an object-oriented File interface for reading and writing streams.

print

Signature
print(any, ...) -> Null

Prints one or more values to standard output, separated by commas, followed by a newline.

Parameters:
- ...args: Values to display in the console.

Returns:
- Null

Usage: 
# Basic variable definition
var msg = "Hello, world!"
print(msg, 42)

read

Signature
read(path: String) -> String

Reads the entire contents of a file at the given path into a string.

Parameters:
- path: The path to the file.

Returns:
- String: File contents, or Null on failure.

Usage: 
var content = read("data.txt")

write

Signature
write(path: String, content: String) -> Null

Writes text content to a target file, creating or completely overwriting it.

Parameters:
- path: Destination file path.
- content: Text payload to write.

Returns:
- Null

Usage: 
write("output.txt", "Hello World")

input

Signature
input(prompt: String = "") -> String

Reads a single line of standard input from the console after displaying an optional prompt string.

Parameters:
- prompt: (Optional) Text prompt to show before waiting for user input.

Returns:
- String: User input stripped of trailing newlines.

Usage: 
var name = input("Enter your name: ")

append

Signature
append(path: String, content: String) -> Null

Appends text content to the end of a specified file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist.

Parameters:
- path: Destination file path.
- content: Text payload to append.

Returns:
- Null

Usage: 
append("log.txt", "New entry\n")

exists

Signature
exists(path: String) -> Bool

Checks whether a given path exists on the file system.

Parameters:
- path: File or directory path to verify.

Returns:
- Bool: true if the path exists, otherwise false.

Usage: 
if exists("config.json") {
    # File found
}

delete

Signature
delete(path: String) -> Null

Deletes a file from the file system.

Parameters:
- path: Path of the file to remove.

Returns:
- Null

Usage: 
delete("temp.tmp")

error

Signature
error(message: String = "error() was called") -> Null

Raises a fatal runtime error with an optional descriptive message, halting VM execution.

Parameters:
- message: (Optional) Error reason text.

Returns:
- Null

Usage: 
error("Fatal crash")

File.write

Signature
File.write(content: String) -> Null

Writes content to the handle's target file starting at the current cursor offset.

Parameters:
- content: Text buffer to write.

Returns:
- Null

File.writeline

Signature
File.writeline(line: String) -> Null

Writes content to the handle's target file and appends a trailing newline character.

Parameters:
- line: Line string to write.

Returns:
- Null

File.cursor

Signature
File.cursor(pos: Int) -> Int

Moves the internal byte read/write stream cursor position within the file.

Parameters:
- pos: Absolute byte offset from start of file.

Returns:
- Int: New absolute byte cursor position.

File.getline

Signature
File.getline() -> String

Reads and returns the next line of text from the file starting from current cursor position.

Returns:
- String: Next text line (excluding newline characters).

File.getlines

Signature
File.getlines() -> List

Resets the file pointer to byte 0 and reads every line into a list of strings.

Returns:
- List: List containing strings for each line in the file.

File

Signature
File(path: String) -> File

Instantiates an object-oriented stream file reference open for reading and writing.

Parameters:
- path: The file system target path.

Returns:
- File: An instance of a File object providing streaming methods.

Usage: 
var f = File("notes.txt")
f.writeline("Hello")
var lines = f.getlines()
